content:
I get the following error message: simp failed: maximum number of steps exceeded

This error message is generated when Veil is processing a particular action

How do I adjust this limit?

In principle, it should be possible to override simp's default maxSteps setting and expose it as an option in Veil.

That said, when this error occurs, my first suspicion would be that something unexpected is going on, unless the action being processed is genuinely enormous. Hitting the default simplification step limit is often a sign that simp is getting stuck repeatedly rewriting terms or dealing with a particularly complicated expression.

Would you be able to share the action that triggers this error?

This is part of (https://github.com/verse-lab/veil/issues/5) that was created March 12

If you look at ord_live-0.3.txt you'll see this issue when you search for XXX

Uncomment action step_memc to re-create this particular issue (I just tried now)
